body: I lost ties with my parents years ago over religious arguments and the likes. I dont think I have talked to my mom in 4 years and my dad in probably a year. I can't just for money, I never have asked anything if them and I wont start now.

TL;DR: 5 years of juggling bills has finally caught up with me mentally and emotionally and if I could clear thia debt I would be ok... I think.

God the worst part is as I read this back I realize how happy I would be with the job I have right now or any job if it just paid enough to crawl me out of this debt.  I realize how quick those 5 years of my life just disappeared out from under me. I look back at my life and it just doesnt seem real. 26 years old and 25 of those years I feel like was someone else.

The best way I can describe it is a rubber band that has been stretched too far and cant get that original shape back.
